text:
maria: Heads-up — Acme RFP came back. They flagged a few CAIQ items where they want explicit shared-responsibility language (KMS, audit logging, key rotation). Also asking for POC timing and whether Dedicated pricing can be capped for the trial. Can we align answers + POC owner?
ben: I can handle the Dedicated pricing note. short answer: we can offer a capped trial for 30 days with an agreed throughput cap. need Rodrigo to confirm GPU types.
amaria: ok, thx. for CAIQ wording we should be precise about who controls keys and logs. ethan, can you draft the short shared-resp sentences? they want copy-paste text for the questionnaire.
ethan (security): sure. quick clarifications: hosted vs dedicated vs private differ. suggested phrasing below — please review.
ethan (security): ```
- Encryption at rest: Redwood manages disk-level and object encryption for Hosted. For Dedicated, customers may opt for BYOK; Redwood will integrate customer keys via KMS and will not have access to plaintext keys.
- Key management: Customer responsible for key lifecycle (creation, rotation, revocation) when BYOK is enabled. Redwood is responsible for integrating with customer KMS and protecting keys in transit.
- Audit logging: Redwood provides control-plane and inference request logs for Hosted/Dedicated. Customers are responsible for retaining application-level logs and any data they send to the model.
```
ben: That looks good. Can we add a one-liner about telemetry/data used for product improvement? Acme asked about model telemetry retention.
ethan (security): yes: `Redwood may collect anonymized telemetry and aggregate usage metrics; no customer PII is used for model training unless explicitly agreed in contract.`
samir (sales-eng): I’ll own the POC schedule. proposed timeline: Week 0: NDA & environment checklist, Week 1: Dedicated trial provisioned (capped), Week 2: integration + sample prompts, Week 3: evaluation + handoff. Need customer network contacts and whether they require VPC peering.
maria: Perfect. Ben — can you write the pricing cap blurb for the CAIQ answer? we want a short sentence.
ben: `For the 30-day trial, Redwood will cap Dedicated inference spend at $X (negotiated) and will provide usage alerts at 75%/90% thresholds.` 
maria: great. ethan — can you paste the CAIQ control IDs we referenced so sales can map them?
ethan (security): quick list: CCM-EN-01 (encryption), CCM-IM-03 (logging), CCM-KEY-02 (key mgmt). I'll dump the official mapping into the shared drive.
security-bot: CAIQ draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/Acme/CAIQ-draft-v1.docx :paperclip:
maria: awesome. I'll assemble the answers and send to Acme legal. anyone see risks?
ben: only ask: if they require HSM-backed keys on Dedicated, timeline might slip 1-2 weeks for infra approvals.
ethan (security): noted — add that as a conditional in the CAIQ note.
maria: ok adding conditional. Samir, kick off POC invite with the timeline. Closing this thread after I send the doc. :thumbsup:
samir (sales-eng): on it. Invite going out now.
maria: thanks all — cc'ing Rodrigo after doc is live.
rodrigo: (joined late) saw the doc, confirming GPU types and can approve capped spend.
maria: perfect — lock and send.
